name: Infernal Pactbreaker Dedication

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

prerequisites: trained in Legal Lore or Religion
text:
Access You're from Isger.

---
Your studies allow you to wield the magic locked within infernal contracts without surrendering your soul. You gain a contract folio with four common divine cantrips of your choice, which functions as a spellbook; this folio may be a collection of contracts you have already studied or the charred remains of one you were once bound to. You gain the Cast a Spell activity. You can prepare two cantrips each day from your folio. You're trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics. Your key spellcasting attribute for infernal pactbreaker spells is Intelligence, and they are divine infernal pactbreaker spells. You can always use Legal Lore or Religion to Decipher the Writing of a contract, and if you roll a critical failure on such a check, you get a failure instead.

Infernal Pactbreaker
